_week: 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-01 (Week 44). Written from this week's numbers.
week_story: Revenue fell 12% to $3,242 (from $3,664) on 71 units vs 99, but net payout rose to $787 from $450 because ad spend was cut 31% to $991.
Most of the unit drop is the Odor Eliminator: 2 units vs 27 the week before. Sellerise shows it at 0 units in stock, and it lost the Buy Box repeatedly over the weekend.
Cleaning Solution grew 75% to $948 (23 units); the Shoe Cleaner Kits slipped 13% to $1,981.
refunds: Refunds were $158 on 5 units (7.1% of orders) vs $86 and 3.1% the week before.
Two kit refunds (Signature and Starter) and one Refresh Kit refund account for most of the money; worth checking the return reasons on the kits.
pacing_reco: Only 1 day of November is in, so the month projection is not reliable yet. The levers are getting the Odor Eliminator and Suede Kit back in stock and keeping ACoS falling.
ads_context: ACoS improved to 52.0% from 59.0% and TACoS to 30.6% from 39.1% as spend came down $440.
That is still well above early October: the week of Oct 5–11 ran at 32.0% ACoS and 16.4% TACoS.
ads_strategy: Branded keywords returned $491 on $131 spend (26.8% ACoS, 11 orders).
Category keywords took most of the budget: $572 for $1,131 in sales (50.5% ACoS), 29% less spend than last week.
Auto campaigns spent $146 for $148 in sales, and remarketing (Sponsored Display) spent $18 with no sales.
bid_moves: Pause “shoe cleaning kit” exact in the Deodorizer campaign: $68.54 spent for one $9.88 order.
Cut the Essential Kit auto campaign: $94 spent, no sales this week.
Keep budget on “shoe cleaner” phrase (30.3% ACoS, 6 orders) and lower the broad bid (38.7% ACoS, $174 spent).
coupons: This week: 48 coupon orders (45 last week).
promotions: This week: 11 promotion orders and $214 in promotional discounts (vs 22 orders and $230 last week).
October in total: $979 in promotional discounts on 96 promotion orders.
events: Black Friday / Cyber Monday: Nov 27 – Nov 30.
Deal and coupon set-up deadlines: to confirm with the account team.
Priority: Odor Eliminator, Suede Kit and Waterproof Spray stocked at FBA before Nov 20.

That means the review tracker isn't pulling for this marketplace, not that there were no reviews.

With refunds at 7.1% this week, read the newest 1–3 star reviews on the Signature and Starter Kits.
recommendations: Restock the Odor Eliminator: 0 in stock in Sellerise, 44 units sold in the last 30 days, and its Buy Box keeps flipping.
